'''Johan Van der Meer Ralltiir Operations II''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Johan Van der Meer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds75.htm Ralltiir Operations II], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002729/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds75.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
